_comment: Citation recognizer round 7 (2026-10-19): Cicero, De legibus, imported from The Latin Library as texts/la/cicero.de_legibus.tess (cic. leg. book.section). The table had no record for it, so the 50 journal citations to it were mis-sent to De amicitia (removed 2026-10-19 morning) or could not link. Per base_id, the record to add (new_work) and the forms to append, for scripts/citations/apply_abbrev_patch.py, to be applied to data/citations/abbreviations.json when the citation indexes are next rebuilt. Author forms are Cic., C. and CIC.; work forms are Leg., Legg., de Leg., De Legibus and Laws. `allow_overlap` lists the author forms every Cicero record already carries (Cic., C., CIC.) and the two bare work forms Leg. and Laws, which plato.leges also carries: without the list the dry run reports 136 conflicts. A bare Leg. should stay with Plato unless Cicero is named, as the rule "leg" in backend/citations/abbrev_context_rules.json already makes it; a rule for cicero.de_legibus with an author-context test is needed alongside this patch. No article text.
